SELECT 
    recov_don_registry,
    don_crtn_val,
    don_gfr_val,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(don_crtn_val, '[^0-9.]', '') as cr_numeric,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(don_gfr_val, '[^0-9.]', '') as gfr_numeric
FROM function_and_recovery
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    recov_don_registry,
    don_crtn_val,
    don_gfr_val,
    SPLIT_PART(don_crtn_val, ' ', 1) as cr_numeric,
    SPLIT_PART(don_gfr_val, ' ', 1) as gfr_numeric
FROM function_and_recovery
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    recov_don_registry,
    SPLIT_PART(don_crtn_val, ' ', 1)::numeric as cr,
    SPLIT_PART(don_gfr_val, ' ', 1)::numeric as gfr,
    ROUND(CAST((1.0 * SPLIT_PART(don_gfr_val, ' ', 1)::numeric) - (10.0 * SPLIT_PART(don_crtn_val, ' ', 1)::numeric) AS numeric), 2) as renal_score
FROM function_and_recovery
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       COUNT(don_crtn_val) as has_cr, 
       COUNT(don_gfr_val) as has_gfr
FROM function_and_recovery;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_donor_renal_score(p_donor_id text)
RETURNS TABLE(donor_id text, renal_score numeric) AS $$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        fr.recov_don_registry,
        ROUND(
            CAST(
                (1.0 * SPLIT_PART(fr.don_gfr_val, ' ', 1)::numeric) 
                - (10.0 * SPLIT_PART(fr.don_crtn_val, ' ', 1)::numeric) 
            AS numeric), 2
        )
    FROM function_and_recovery fr
    WHERE fr.recov_don_registry = p_donor_id;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
